items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 27 August 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving area of low pressure to the southwest of Britain, with associated troughs drifting northwards.


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 this afternoon, becoming cyclonic 2 to 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the south, turning heavy at times. Becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in places.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Cyclonic 2 to 4, becoming west or northwest 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon, backing south or southwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, scattered showers later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate later.
